purpose: Measure operational sensitivity of the locked readouts to bounded attention-head group ablations across Base, NER-specialized, and NLI-specialized LFM2.5-230M backbones.

input_sample.population: all existing TEST input partitions only
input_sample.global_selection: smallest SHA256(seed|world_id) values within each (split,surface_family) stratum
input_sample.graph_pair_selection: reservoir chosen by smallest SHA256(seed|split|family|row_idx|a_idx|b_idx), never by target label

interventions.attention_layers: last four modules whose config layer_types entry is full_attention
interventions.first_level: zero every query-head output entering the selected layer out_proj, one selected layer at a time
interventions.group_level: zero one contiguous query-head group sharing a single KV head, at a time, within each selected layer

analysis.primary: prediction flips and logit/margin movement relative to each model/readout's existing unmasked cached baseline
analysis.graph_reporting: frozen edge head score delta, sign-flip rate, and score-rank correlation; no accuracy or label join
analysis.claim_boundary: operational ablation sensitivity only; no causal mechanism claim

stop_rule: Finish layer and KV-group masks only. Individual-head masking is a separately named follow-up limited to members of a group with a clear selective effect.
